# UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage

> > Official platform for UNESCO's work on safeguarding intangible cultural heritage worldwide through the 2003 Convention, including the Representative List, Urgent Safeguarding List, and Register of Good Safeguarding Practices.

This site serves as the primary resource for the Intergovernmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage, documenting living heritage practices including oral traditions, performing arts, and traditional crafts. It provides access to committee sessions, heritage lists, and guidance on cultural diversity and heritage transmission across member states.

## Key Topics

- Intangible Cultural Heritage
- 2003 Convention
- Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity
- List of Intangible Cultural Heritage in Need of Urgent Safeguarding
- Register of Good Safeguarding Practices
- Intergovernmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage
- Cultural Diversity
- Oral Traditions
- Performing Arts
- Traditional Crafts
- Heritage Safeguarding
- Cultural Transmission
- Committee Sessions
- Heritage Definition
- Living Heritage

- [What is Intangible Cultural Heritage?](https://ich.unesco.org/debug/en/what-is-intangible-heritage-00003): Defines UNESCO's intangible cultural heritage concept and scope
